senses.gloss_en: shutter (a device like a door opaquely closing a window opening)
to taste, to try (to sample the flavor of something orally)
to stud, hobnail (sole of a boot or shoe)
octave (an interval of twelve semitones, representing a doubling or halving in pitch frequency)
occupied (under the control of a foreign military presence)
to occupy (to take control of a country or region by a hostile army)
